## Problem

What customer pain or incident motivates this?

## Proposed solution

What does the feature look like?

## What Don't-Lie proves today

Restate what we already prove, so the feature doesn't accidentally claim
more than the receipts can support. (Linked: SECURITY.md.)

## Out of scope

- Multi-machine trust reconciliation (v2).
- Native Anthropic Messages (planned).
- Encrypted sync (planned).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Test that fails without the feature and passes with it.
- [ ] Docs updated.
- [ ] Brand voice preserved (no "truth verified" / "tamper-proof").
